fact_statement: P_ADJUST_REVENUE runs at 02:15 IST, after the 01:00 IST nightly load completes. Within that run P_RECALC_SCHEME_DISCOUNT reaches the OMS_PROD.INVOICE_LINE update at about 02:40 IST and P_POST_GL_SUMMARY posts at about 02:55 IST. FORBIDDEN IN EVERY FORM ELSEWHERE: the time 02:15, the time 02:40, the time 02:55, or any rendering of any of them ('quarter past two', '2.15 am', 'around 2.40', 'twenty to three', '02:40 hrs', 'just after two'); any statement that a procedure runs after the load; any statement that the recalculation rewrites rows that were already extracted; and any ordering claim between the load and the procedure. The load's own 01:00 start and its ~02:05 completion are F-LOADSTART, not this fact, and are shared. CANON.md, schema_canon.sql, procs_canon.sql, procs_canon.md and odi_canon.md are canon-internal and may state it; nothing in _sources/ may.
